rule: V7 is the single final destination. Preserve PAPER-only safety. The required lifecycle is V7 implementation -> tests -> same-SHA PAPER -> main -> paper-validated -> deploy -> server health -> legacy deletion. A premature cleanup already occurred; do not resurrect V3-V6 wholesale. Recover only primitives actually required for this V7 lifecycle into V7/common/control-plane with equivalent tests, then continue deleting superseded surfaces only when the exact V7 cutover makes them unnecessary.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard ceiling, not a target. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, joint completion, partial/unwind loss, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase
architecture.recovery_after_premature_cleanup: Do not restore retired numerical generations wholesale. Port only required cutover/data/monitoring primitives into V7/common/control-plane and prove them with current V7 tests.
architecture.legacy_rule: Do not add new logic to V3/V4/V5/V6. Any primitive still required by V7 must live in V7/common before final retirement. Git history is the archive.

economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, partial/unwind losses, markout, cost stress and no leakage

model_contracts.fast_structural_arb: first economic frontier; use event-driven/local L2 state where possible, dual exchange/receive clocks, stale/sequence continuity checks, authoritative per-market fees, executable depth, sequential leg revalidation and explicit partial/unwind accounting
model_contracts.graph_rv: prospective dual-clock joint-state evidence only; queue ahead reduces fillability and must not grant capital; compare maker/maker, maker/taker, taker/maker, taker/taker, sequential, near-simultaneous, join, improve and cross by total executable EV; explicit partial-state unwind
model_contracts.cross_sectional_ranking: relative top-vs-bottom executable ranking; evaluate 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; do not pool inference across horizons; frozen holdout model is fit once strictly before holdout_start minus embargo and is never refit inside the frozen holdout; online walk-forward evidence is separate
model_contracts.micro_taker: complete executable round-trip target with entry ask VWAP, expected/realized exit bid VWAP, both authoritative fees, slippage, uncertainty, adverse markout and capital-time costs; open positions mark to full-depth executable liquidation net of exit fee or fail closed
model_contracts.external_intelligence: run in parallel; inventory existing implementation and portfolio workspace read-only first; all features/probability mappings must be point-in-time; raw external features never become a synthetic terminal probability without approved causal mapping and evidence
model_contracts.learned_execution: estimate P(fill|X,a), fill-conditioned markout and multi-leg joint state distributions empirically for join/improve/fade/cross/size/timeout/cancel/replace and expose them to all strategies
model_contracts.micro_maker: selective incentive-aware maker only; optimize trading PnL and rewards separately; unconditional always-improve is not alpha; queue, OFI, imbalance, microprice, depth, toxicity, cancel latency and adverse markout are required
model_contracts.pca: single-leg residual statistical arbitrage only; evaluate 30m, 1h, 2h and 6h separately; no mandatory hedge basket, terminal-probability semantics or binary Kelly
model_contracts.local_factor: pair-specific panels, pair-excluded orientation-invariant factor basis, same-basis null-preserving inference, dependence-robust multiplicity, horizon-matched forecasts and explicit execution economics

rules: keep state, PnL, labels and inference separate by frequency
do not select a new frequency post hoc on the same holdout
new frequencies require prospective chronological evidence
frozen holdout evidence and adaptive walk-forward evidence must never be mixed

current_priority_order: Repair any current bug that invalidates economic or exact-SHA evidence, including missing V7 cutover primitives caused by the premature cleanup.
Fast Structural Arb/HFT: maximize executable structural-arbitrage feedback with event-driven L2, strict dual-clock freshness, depth, fees, latency, partial/unwind and cost-stressed PAPER evidence.
Graph/RV execution: remove queue-coupled capital sizing, estimate empirical joint completion and optimize entry style by total executable EV.
Cross-sectional Ranking 15m: keep 15m/30m/1h/2h/6h separate and repair frozen-holdout refit leakage before interpreting OOS evidence.
Micro Taker: selective short-horizon complete-round-trip execution after spread, fees, slippage and adverse move.
External Fair Value: continue point-in-time external data collection in parallel, reusing existing infrastructure and read-only portfolio data where provenance-safe.
Learned Execution: estimate fill, joint completion and fill-conditioned markout from the canonical execution ledger.
Selective Incentive-Aware Maker: use fill-conditioned net trading economics plus separately reported rewards.
PCA/Local Factor refinements only where forward evidence justifies them.
Restore one economically useful V7 monitoring/deploy/health plane without resurrecting retired numerical generations.

After one exact V7 SHA is on main, paper-validated, deployed and server-health green, aggressively delete every remaining superseded adapter/workflow/config/test/dashboard/transitional bridge no longer imported by V7/common.

scheduler_assignments.administrator-supervisor: Treat this V7 master directive as current authority; report collisions, mixed-SHA evidence, duplicate writers and premature cleanup/cutover regressions.
scheduler_assignments.research-policy: Enforce V7-only new development, PAPER/authenticated separation, branch provenance, no duplicate ownership and same-SHA evidence. Do not require restoring retired numerical generations.
scheduler_assignments.research-queue: Allocate work by the current priority order and avoid lanes already owned by another active agent/PR.
scheduler_assignments.promotion-controller: Promote only exact-provenance V7 integrations with required technical and economic evidence; CI or quoted edge alone is not alpha.
scheduler_assignments.integration-merge: Remain the single canonical V7 integration writer; merge exactly one policy-compatible V7 integration after exact-head checks.
scheduler_assignments.control-plane-event-bridge: Dispatch only existing authorized controller/integration workflows.
scheduler_assignments.post-merge-validation: Validate the exact merged SHA and require the same revision through live-paper validation, paper-validated, deployment and health.
scheduler_assignments.code-validation: Validate deterministic V7/common tests, operator-directive contracts, canonical ledger/runtime ownership and same-SHA deployment contracts.
scheduler_assignments.monitoring-validation: Validate one canonical V7-oriented monitoring plane and per-strategy/frequency execution/PnL/data-health observability.
scheduler_assignments.live-paper-validation: Run public-data PAPER validation of the exact candidate SHA; never mix evidence across SHAs.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-deploy: Deploy only the exact paper-validated V7 revision after the normal gate; never deploy research branches or authenticated execution.
scheduler_assignments.paper-server-health: Verify deployed SHA, one runtime owner, one state writer, recorder/book freshness, ledger growth, fills/PnL/markouts, Grafana/exporter and scheduler health on deployed V7.
scheduler_assignments.forward-maker-research: Collect selective maker evidence only and keep trading PnL separate from rewards.
scheduler_assignments.alpha-factory: Select V7 challengers by forward/OOS executable economics, point-in-time causality, cost stress and reject/pass criteria.
scheduler_assignments.meta-supervisor: Coordinate V7-only research, single-writer surfaces and exact-SHA lifecycle.
scheduler_assignments.fast-arb-shadow-research: Highest-priority alpha research lane: strict dual-clock freshness, continuity, executable depth, verified fees, legging/partial/unwind and latency accounting.
scheduler_assignments.arb-theory-research: Derive structural/Graph candidates under the V7 executable joint-state contract.
scheduler_assignments.external-intelligence: Collect point-in-time public external information in parallel and keep probability mapping fail closed.
scheduler_assignments.live-api-smoke: Read-only Gamma/CLOB connectivity and freshness only.
scheduler_assignments.v7-point-in-time-universe-archive: Maintain immutable V7 point-in-time universes; no competing market-data writer.
scheduler_assignments.v7-unified-paper-evidence: Reconcile only exact-green V7 research heads into isolated per-SHA PAPER evidence; never merge/deploy or mutate canonical refs/champion.
scheduler_assignments.v7-cross-sectional-ranking-research: Repair frozen-holdout semantics then collect horizon-separated ranking evidence including 15m.

forbidden_regressions: Do not create V8/V9/V10 or another numerical runtime generation.
Do not add new strategy/runtime logic to V3/V4/V5/V6 or resurrect them wholesale.
Do not delete or omit V7 cutover primitives required for same-SHA PAPER -> main -> paper-validated -> deploy -> health.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not create a second live state writer, broker owner, execution ledger, canonical integration or duplicated scheduler.
Do not call quoted edge, assumed fills, in-sample Sharpe or CI success profitable alpha.
Do not use product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities as a generic multi-leg joint completion estimator.
Do not mix frozen-holdout evidence with adaptive refits or pool ranking/PCA evidence across horizons.
Do not write scheduler-generated code or artifacts outside authorized repository/runtime/evidence paths; the portfolio workspace is read-only by default.
